description: Compact and efficient. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Clear functional corridor connecting zones. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: L-shaped sofa in lower right area facing the TV on the right exterior wall; dining table with four chairs in the upper right. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall right of entry. Cook cannot see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is blank wall, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Double bedroom closest to entry — lighter acoustic separation from the arrival zone. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor, desk visible. Secondary bedroom 2 — accessed via own door off corridor. Each single bedroom can function as a dedicated home office, hobby room, guest room, or children's bedroom. 1 of 2 have a desk visible in plan. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room / home office + children's bedroom simultaneously. Storage: one wardrobe. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet); separate WC. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible. Suits: families with two or more children; multi-generational households. Not suitable for: households needing a home office with natural light; wheelchair users requiring wide turning corridors; large families needing more than one bathroom.
